plan: The dominant strategy in this auction game is to bid your own valuation of the prize. Since my value for the prize is $32, I will bid exactly $32. This strategy maximizes expected profit by ensuring I only win when the prize is worth more to me than the cost I pay. Given that this is a single round and there's no history to learn from, sticking to the dominant strategy is optimal.
